environment.description: Same ASP.NET Core 6.0 service deployed on AKS (Azure Kubernetes Service) with Split Evaluator sidecar. The Split workspace has the 'xml-parsing-mode' feature flag configured with a default rule returning treatment 'secure' and a kill switch that was activated on 2024-01-15 setting all environments to 'off' (which maps to 'secure' treatment in the YAML split definition). The Split Evaluator sidecar at localhost:3141 reflects this killed state. Additionally, the pod's appsettings.json has XmlParsing:DefaultMode set to 'secure' via a Kubernetes ConfigMap (document-service-config, key parsing-defaults). The ConfigMap is protected by an OPA Gatekeeper ConstraintTemplate (K8sDisallowedConfigValues) that rejects any mutation setting XmlParsing:DefaultMode to 'legacy' in the 'prod' namespace. Split SDK API key used by the evaluator has read-only scope and the split definition is locked by Split's environment-level approval workflow requiring 2 approvals from the security-reviewers group to change treatments in production.

config.split_governance: environment approval workflow, 2 approvals from security-reviewers required
config.configmap_protection: OPA Gatekeeper K8sDisallowedConfigValues blocks 'legacy' value in prod namespace
config.network_policy: default-deny egress except DNS and split-proxy
